name: cadence
description: A disciplined workflow plugin for Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, and other SKILL.md runtimes: propose, investigate, implement, review, verify, ship, and reflect.

interface.shortDescription: Engineering workflow guardrails and stack conventions for Codex.
interface.longDescription: Cadence packages durable engineering rules and workflow modes for Codex. It imports the canonical SKILL.md files and exposes Codex-friendly command shims for propose, investigate, plan, diff-check, verify, ship, audit, reflect, and promote.
defaultPrompt: Use Cadence to plan this change.
Run a Cadence diff-check on my work.
Use Cadence to verify and ship this.
